headline: Legendary Dolly Parton dies at 80 after brief cancer battle
deck: The country icon and global philanthropist leaves behind a legacy of music, generosity, and unshakable faith as tributes pour in from across the world.
body: Dolly Parton, the indomitable figure of country music and cultural icon, has died at 80 after a brief battle with cancer, as reported by multiple outlets. The announcement marked the end of an era for a woman whose six-decade career reshaped the genre and whose generosity left an indelible mark on millions. Parton’s death comes as a shock to fans who admired her resilience, humor, and relentless work ethic, even in her final months. Dollywood, her Tennessee theme park, observed a moment of silence in her honor by remaining closed on the day of her passing.

Parton’s faith remained her compass until the end, according to People.com, which reported her steadfast optimism in the face of illness. Her unyielding belief in divine timing was captured in her own words: 'It’s Not Over Until God Says It’s Over.' That mantra reflected a life lived on her own terms—a woman who turned adversity into artistry and hardship into hope. Even as her health declined, she continued to inspire those around her with her trademark wit and grace.
It’s Not Over Until God Says It’s Over

Parton’s influence extended far beyond music. She was a collaborator on Beyoncé’s recent album Cowboy Carter, contributing vocals and co-writing the track 'Spaghetti.' Beyoncé paid tribute to Parton in Rolling Stone, calling her 'You Were the Barometer'—a nod to her ability to set the standard in both art and authenticity. The collaboration highlighted Parton’s enduring relevance, proving that her voice and vision transcended generations.

Beyond her musical achievements, Parton was a philanthropist whose Imagination Library has gifted over 200 million books to children worldwide. Her commitment to education and literacy cemented her legacy as much more than a performer. In a career spanning from 9 to 5 to Jolene, she became a symbol of Southern resilience and artistic fearlessness. Her death leaves a void that will be felt across industries and continents.

The outpouring of grief and admiration underscores her global impact. From Nashville to London, artists and fans alike have shared memories of her kindness, talent, and larger-than-life personality. Dolly Parton was not just a star; she was a force of nature, a woman who turned dreams into reality through sheer determination and an unmatched work ethic.

Tributes have poured in from figures across entertainment, politics, and beyond, reflecting the breadth of her cultural footprint. Her death at 80 closes a chapter in music history, but her influence will endure through her music, her charity, and the generations she inspired. Dolly Parton was, and always will be, irreplaceable.

pipelineSteps.detail: Aggregated reports from TMZ, The New York Times, People.com, Knoxville News Sentinel, and Rolling Stone confirmed Dolly Parton's death and provided details on her illness and public tributes.

pipelineSteps.detail: Extracted age at death (80), confirmation of cancer battle, faith-based quotes, Dollywood closure, and Beyoncé's tribute from six verified sources.

pipelineSteps.detail: Wove Parton's career legacy with her philanthropic contributions and cultural impact, using direct quotes to emphasize her unshakable spirit and global influence.
